systems.system: MESOB one-stop service platform and centres
systems.country_label: MESOB (Modern Ethiopian Service for Organised Benefits)
systems.tiers: federal one-stop centre that began with 41 services; extended to Addis Ababa (Addis MESOB), Oromia and other regions, a centre in Dire Dawa, and a solar-powered mobile bus

systems.country_label: Oromia MESOB and other regional MESOB offices
systems.tiers: regions; tethered to the separate systems of the institutions, where in Addis Ababa MESOB has absorbed institutions' systems

systems.owner: approved by a board established by the prime minister

note: The article concerns one-stop service centres run by federal, city and regional MESOB bodies and how institutions' services are integrated; it names no woreda or city administration office and states nothing on any office's connection.
